name: Vistar Amar Limited
about: Vistar Amar Limited engages in manufacturing and sale of fishmeal in India. It offers fishmeal and fish oil from marine fish and fish waste. The company was formerly known as Shubhra Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited and changed its name to Vistar Amar Limited in May 2017. Vistar Amar Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Porbandar, India.
